description: resolved_case_candidates.csv row had likely_outcome_year=2021 (wrong; deal was 2019). All EDGAR query URLs used 2021 date ranges — merger_8k_query searched 2021-01-01 to 2021-12-31 so would return no results; prior_signal_query and proxy_query enddt was 2021-12-31. Adjudicator would find no merger 8-K and incorrectly conclude the deal was undocumented.
